case_number: 2024 INSC 252; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4806 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4807 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4808 OF 2011, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4809 OF 2011

parties.petitioner: Krishnadatt Awasthy; Sumer Singh; Smt. Ramrani Singh; Smt. Shyama Dewedi & Ors.

summary: Appointment of close relatives of selection committee members for Shiksha Karmi posts; violation of natural justice and bias; MP Panchayat Raj Act, Section 40(C) prohibition on financial benefits to relatives; Collector quashed selection, respondents failed to deny relationships; revision dismissed based on lack of prejudice despite non-joinder; writ petition filed but inspection provided; appointments cancelled for arbitrariness and contravention of statutory prohibitions.
legal_provisions_cited: MP Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993 s.40(C)
MP Panchayat (Appeal and Revision) Rules, 1995 s.5
final_judgment: Appointments cancelled and judgments setting aside appointments upheld.
